snippet.title: Manala: Equinox War | Mini-MMO Deckbuilder | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Manala is a deckbuilding mini-MMO with full-loot PvP. Your gear writes your deck, and when you die you drop all of it.

🛒 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4898080/
🎮 Free demo: out now

Fights are card fights, against monsters and against other players, alone or in a band of up to five. Card stats adjust as you swap out gear - the same card that does 3 damage with a one-hander does 7 with a two-hander. Equip a shield and enable Block, Guard Stance and Shield Bash. The equipment on your body decides which cards you can play.

Walk the rooms, talk to the people who live in them and take the work they offer. Cut coal out of a vein. Carry it to a bench, make the sword yourself, put it on and watch the cards in your hands change.

Then you can lose all of it. When you die you drop everything you were carrying. Anyone who walks past can loot it and the person who killed you is already standing over it.

Every enemy in the world works the same way. An NPC draws its cards from the gear it is carrying so its deck is its loot table. The sword that was beating you is the sword you pick up.

Nothing scales. No levels, no multipliers: you have between 5HP and 12HP.

23 regions change hands on a live map, Light against Darkness, and at the autumn equinox the Frog of the North judges the year. 5 classes, 2 sides, 1 map. 

Built solo, launching November 5, 2026.

💬 Discord, come argue with me: https://discord.gg/MS9vXquzMX

🎵 "Achaidh Cheide" by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com)
